tactical_move: commit the PC's demand to an external body by making the dispatch visible and received
state_change_precondition: No sealed demand for investigation has yet left the PC's hands.
state_change: The PC places the sealed letter into the courier's hands and watches it carried away.
forces_choice: forces the PC to choose between remaining at the toll road to intercept the first reply or riding out to gather independent witnesses before the commission arrives
branch_a: remain at the toll road to intercept the first reply
branch_b: ride out to gather independent witnesses before the commission arrives
scene_purpose: make the player's demand to the commission an irreversible, witnessed action that opens external pressure
forward_pressure: the commission will now respond to the sealed demand

event_slots.precondition: The PC and a courier are both present in the scene.
event_slots.exit_state: the sealed demand for investigation has been dispatched
